from pathlib import Path
import ast
for name in ('basic', 'expr', 'numbers'):
    path = Path('sympy/core/%s.py' % name)

    edits = []
    for cls in tree.body:
        if not isinstance(cls, ast.ClassDef):
            continue
        for method in cls.body:
            if not isinstance(method, ast.FunctionDef) or method.name not in ('__eq__', '__ne__', '__lt__', '__le__', '__gt__', '__ge__'):
                continue
            for node in ast.walk(method):
                if isinstance(node, ast.ExceptHandler) and isinstance(node.type, ast.Name) and node.type.id == 'SympifyError':
                    stmt = node.body[0]
                    edits.append((stmt.lineno - 1, stmt.end_lineno, ' ' * stmt.col_offset + 'return NotImplemented\\n'))
            if method.name == '__ne__' and len(method.body) >= 1:
                stmt = method.body[-1]
                if isinstance(stmt, ast.Return) and ast.get_source_segment(source, stmt) == 'return not self.__eq__(other)':
                    edits.append((stmt.lineno - 1, stmt.end_lineno,
                        '        result = self.__eq__(other)\\n'
                        '        if result is NotImplemented:\\n'
                        '            return NotImplemented\\n'
                        '        return not result\\n'))
            if name == 'numbers' and cls.name in ('Infinity', 'NegativeInfinity', 'NaN'):

                    stmt = method.body[-1]
                    edits.append((stmt.lineno - 1, stmt.lineno - 1,
                        '        try:\\n'
                        '            _sympify(other)\\n'
                        '        except SympifyError:\\n'
                        '            return NotImplemented\\n'
                        '        # Preserve the identity comparison for sympifiable operands.\\n'))

                    stmt = method.body[-1]
                    edits.append((stmt.lineno - 1, stmt.end_lineno,
                        '        result = self.__eq__(other)\\n'
                        '        if result is NotImplemented:\\n'
                        '            return NotImplemented\\n'
                        '        return not result\\n'))
